plot_group <- function(obj, group, title) {
  obj$highlight <- ifelse(
    obj$sample_group == group,
    as.character(obj$annotations),
    "Other"
  )
  obj$highlight <- factor(obj$highlight, levels = c(ann_levels, "Other"))

  DimPlot(
    object = obj,
    reduction = "mde_incremental",
    group.by = "highlight",
    cols = pal,
    order = ann_levels
  ) +
    labs(title = title)
  
  ggsave(paste0(out_path,"figure3b_umap_annotations",title,".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

}

p_nme <- plot_group(igt45_sub, "CoH.D30", "NME 30 dpi")
p_spf <- plot_group(igt45_sub, "SPF.D30", "SPF 30 dpi")
